verdict.rationale: Reducto documents Svix-backed webhooks for production use. They offer cryptographic request signing, automatic retries with exponential backoff and a delivery dashboard, and a Webhooks section in Studio opens the Svix subscription dashboard. These pair with async job endpoints that return job IDs. Missing for 10: an explicit list of subscribable event types (job completion is only implied), detail on how to configure subscriptions via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
